voice: Warm, concrete language with short spoken exchanges.
Let pictures show room geography and the quiet background joke.
teaching: One usable idea: a map becomes easier to follow when it includes familiar landmarks.
Show the consequence of unclear directions, then let the protagonist revise and test them.
content_boundaries: Keep the problem safe and small: a confusing indoor treasure hunt.
Give frustration space without blame or embarrassment.
Both friends may speak; neither fixes the problem through authority.
composition: Six story spreads plus four interior matter pages; covers are separate.
Use one main action per spread; alternate room views with close views.
Reserve clear text zones and keep map clues outside the gutter.
Track the paper star from its hiding place to the final reveal.

extensions.reader_participation: Invite the reader to identify the final landmark before turning the page.
